new.title: Pick the cooking day
new.dayHelper: Pickup and delivery happen on this day. You can change it later.

past.heading: Past menus
past.hint: Open one to see its dishes, or start a new menu from it.
past.empty: No past menus yet. A menu moves here when its cooking day is over.
past.title: Menu for {{date}}
past.dropped: Order details are kept for 4 weeks, so only the totals are left.
past.use: Use these dishes for a new menu
past.addToThis: Add these dishes to this menu

draft.title: Menu for {{date}}
draft.saved: Saved as you go · {{dishes}} dishes picked
draft.deleteBody: Its dishes and places are removed from this menu. Your dishes and saved sets stay.

live.unpublishBody_one: Customers can't open it until you publish again. {{count}} order already placed stays.
live.unpublishBody_other: Customers can't open it until you publish again. {{count}} orders already placed stay.
live.finishBody: Orders still open are closed (pickup becomes collected, delivery becomes delivered) and the menu moves to Past menus. This also happens by itself at midnight after the cooking day.

make.title: Menu for {{date}}
make.instant: Changes go to customers as you make them.

dishes.noneYet: No dishes yet. Add one with New dish.
dishes.noSets: No saved sets yet. Pick dishes, then use Save these as a set.
dishes.full: A menu holds at most {{max}} dishes.
dishes.emptyMenu: Nothing yet. Tick dishes on the left.
dishes.pricesLater: You can change prices and limits for this menu in step 3. Your saved dishes stay as they are.
dishes.setsFull: You have 5 saved sets. Delete one before saving another.
dishes.pastMissing_one: {{count}} dish is no longer in Your dishes, so it was left out.
dishes.pastMissing_other: {{count}} dishes are no longer in Your dishes, so they were left out.
dishes.removedWithOrders_one: {{count}} dish that already has orders was removed. Those orders keep it.
dishes.removedWithOrders_other: {{count}} dishes that already have orders were removed. Those orders keep them.
dishes.removeBody_one: {{count}} portion of {{name}} is already ordered. Those orders keep it.
dishes.removeBody_other: {{count}} portions of {{name}} are already ordered. Those orders keep it.

dish.subNew: Saved to Your dishes for next time.
dish.subEdit: Changes to name, description and size also reach the copy on this menu.
dish.name: Name (English)
dish.seeEnglish: Empty: customers will see the English text.
dish.limitHelper: Customers see "N left" once 5 or fewer remain; the dish sells out at 0.
dish.savedAnyway: (it's saved in Your dishes either way)
dish.menuFull: This menu already has 10 dishes, so the dish was saved but not added.
dish.neverUsed: Not used on a menu yet.
dish.deleteLive: It is on the live menu. It stays there until you remove it, and orders already placed keep it. It is removed from Your dishes and saved sets.
dish.deleteBody: It is removed from Your dishes and saved sets. Menus and orders that used it keep their copy.

err.name: Add a name in at least one language.
err.limit: Enter a whole number of 1 or more, or leave it empty.

prices.title: Prices and limits for this menu
prices.hint: Prices here are for this menu only. Limit: customers see "N left" once 5 or fewer remain; the dish sells out at 0.

details.cookingHelper: Pickup and delivery happen on this day.
details.cutoffHelper_one: {{count}} day before the cooking day. You can still add orders by hand after this.
details.cutoffHelper_other: {{count}} days before the cooking day. You can still add orders by hand after this.
details.cutoffAfter: Orders would close after the cooking day. You can still publish.
details.addressNote: Addresses are agreed on WhatsApp, not stored here.
details.placesHelp: Choose which of your saved places this menu uses. Customers pick one when they order.
details.placeSaved: Saved for every menu that uses this place.
details.placesFull: You have 5 saved places. Delete one before adding another.
details.placesFoot: Edit a place here or in Settings › Pickup locations.
details.deleteUsed: This menu uses it, so customers will no longer see it. Orders already placed keep it.
details.deleteBody: It is removed from your saved places and from any menu that used it.

picture.title: Menu picture
picture.help: A collage of this menu's dishes works best. Customers see it at the top of the menu on their phone.
picture.foot: Each new menu starts without a picture.
picture.image_type: That file is not a picture we can use. Try a JPEG, PNG or WebP.
picture.image_too_big: The picture is too big. Try a smaller one.
picture.image_ratio: The picture has the wrong shape. Use a 3:2 picture.

check.allGood: Nothing to check. Ready when you are.
check.neverBlock: None of these stops you from publishing.

worry.noDishes: This menu has no dishes yet.
worry.noPicture: No menu picture. Customers will see your kitchen banner instead.
worry.noChef_one: {{count}} dish has no chef. It will be listed under the whole kitchen in Kitchen.
worry.noChef_other: {{count}} dishes have no chef. They will be listed under the whole kitchen in Kitchen.
worry.noPlace: No pickup place is chosen and delivery is off, so customers can't pick how to get their order.
worry.dayPast: The cooking day is in the past.
worry.cutoffPast: Orders were set to close before now, so customers can't order.
worry.cutoffAfterDay: Orders close after the cooking day.
worry.deliveryNote: Delivery is on but has no note for customers.

publish.summary: {{dishes}} dishes for {{date}}. Customers can order as soon as it is live.
publish.worries_one: {{count}} thing in Worth a look. You can still publish.
publish.worries_other: {{count}} things in Worth a look. You can still publish.
publish.after: Then you can share the post on WhatsApp.
publish.liveHelp: Customers can order for {{date}}. Share the post below.
publish.emptyTitle: Publish a menu with no dishes?
publish.emptyBody: Customers would see an empty menu and could not order anything.

library.title: Your dishes
library.help: Every dish you have saved. A menu keeps its own copy of the price and limit.

sets.title: Saved sets
sets.help: A saved set is a list of dishes you start a menu from.
sets.addFailed: Could not add the set. A menu holds at most 10 dishes.
